design_detail: Annual progressive wealth tax with PLN 10m exemption and marginal rates from 1% to 8%
quote_original: Proponujemy progresywną skalę podatku majątkowego:
quote_en: We propose a progressive wealth-tax schedule:
source_title: Jak multimilionerzy mogą pomóc w ratowaniu klimatu?
grading_note: Party statement explicitly sets out wealth thresholds and rates; not income or property taxation alone.

design_detail: Wealth-tax-linked exit levy of 40%; 60% above PLN 1bn
quote_original: Ponadto wprowadzimy tzw. exit tax w wysokości 40% majątku
quote_en: We will also introduce an exit tax of 40% of wealth
source_title: Jak multimilionerzy mogą pomóc w ratowaniu klimatu?
grading_note: Explicit anti-avoidance exit levy attached to the party's wealth-tax design.

design_detail: EU tax on large fortunes; declaration adopted at the 8-9 November 2025 congress
quote_original: a także unijnego podatku od wielkich majątków.
quote_en: and also an EU tax on large fortunes.
source_title: Deklaracja programowa: Gospodarka dla ludzi
grading_note: Explicit support for a named EU wealth tax; no rate or threshold here. Adoption date appears on the declaration's parent page. Grade A under the formal-act clause: adopted organisational policy or authored publication recommending a wealth tax.

design_detail: Future net-wealth tax on fortunes of hundreds of millions or billions of PLN
quote_original: W przyszłości również należałoby pomyśleć nad wprowadzeniem podatku od majątków netto
quote_en: In the future we should also consider introducing a tax on net wealth
source_title: Podatek majątkowy w Polsce? Państwo musi wydawać [OPINIA]
grading_note: Author explicitly recommends future net-wealth taxation in addition to property taxes; no specific schedule.

design_detail: Advocates wealth taxation covering property and financial assets to reduce inequality; no own fixed rate
quote_original: Do tego z kolei służą różne formy podatku majątkowego.
quote_en: Various forms of wealth tax serve this purpose.
source_title: 10 najbogatszych osób w Polsce ma tyle, co 6,8 miliona najuboższych
grading_note: Read with the following paragraphs explicitly including company shares and bank deposits and recommending a higher tax to reduce wealth inequality. Grade A under the formal-act clause: adopted organisational policy or authored publication recommending a wealth tax.

design_detail: Coordinated international wealth taxes; discusses billionaire minimum and annual net-wealth designs
quote_original: Wiele problemów rozwiązałoby wprowadzenie globalnych standardów podatkowych na tym polu.
quote_en: Introducing global tax standards in this area would solve many problems.
source_title: Bogaci wyjadą, gospodarka upadnie? Nie tak działają podatki majątkowe
grading_note: Author advocates international wealth-tax coordination and wider adoption; does not merely report other people's positions. Date is the displayed publication date. Grade A under the formal-act clause: adopted organisational policy or authored publication recommending a wealth tax.

design_detail: TDEM manifesto proposes European taxation of large fortunes above EUR1 million; wealth tax forms part of its four-tax European budget proposal.
quote_original: Karolina Borońska , politiste, Université de Wroclaw, Pologne
quote_en: University of Wrocław, Poland
source_title: Les signataires (au 9/12/2018)
grading_note: Named public academic on the manifesto's initial signatory roster dated 9 December 2018. The signed manifesto at https://tdem.eu/pl/manifest/ explicitly includes a tax on large fortunes above EUR1m; roster claim is conservatively B. Identity expanded using University of Wrocław staff records.

design_detail: Supports Saez-Zucman European annual wealth-tax proposal: 1% above EUR2m net wealth, 2% above EUR8m, 3% for billionaires.
quote_original: Wystarczyłoby wprowadzić w życie podatek majątkowy, o którym Saez i Zucman trąbią od wielu lat.
quote_en: It would be enough to implement the wealth tax that Saez and Zucman have advocated for many years.
source_title: COVID-owy jeździec
grading_note: Author's own opinion recommends the named EU wealth-tax design and details its net-wealth thresholds; formal authored-publication clause supports A.

design_detail: EU-wide wealth tax; expressly distinguishes this from a standalone Polish wealth tax, which he opposes.
quote_original: Ja popieram wprowadzenie podatku majątkowego w USA, na poziomie całej Unii też, ale w Polsce to jest nieuzasadnione.
quote_en: I support introducing a wealth tax in the USA, and at EU-wide level too, but in Poland it is unjustified.
source_title: Miliarderzy się bogacą, reszta biednieje. Czas na podatek majątkowy?
grading_note: Named explicit EU-level endorsement without his own rate or threshold. Quote preserves the important exclusion of a standalone Polish tax.

design_detail: Calls for a wealth tax alongside separate progressive income and corporate tax reforms to finance social and health policies.
quote_original: Ale żeby takich wielkich rzeczy dokonywać, trzeba się będzie poważyć na podatek majątkowy
quote_en: But to achieve such great things, we will have to dare to introduce a wealth tax
source_title: Piotr Ikonowicz: Kaczyński chodzi po linie
grading_note: Author's own affirmative recommendation of a wealth tax, explicitly distinguished from income and corporate taxes in the same sentence; authored-publication formal act.

design_detail: Favourably proposes a 2% levy on fortunes of the richer millionaire groups, discusses both PLN3.7m and PLN37m thresholds.
quote_original: obłożyć ich fortunki i fortuny dwuprocentowym podatkiem
quote_en: subject their fortunes to a two-percent tax
source_title: Mamy największy kryzys od dekad. Bez sprawiedliwych podatków z niego nie wyjdziemy
grading_note: Author recommends a specified broad wealth-stock tax as a good start for funding crisis responses; full preceding context defines net wealth including financial assets.

design_detail: Wealth taxes for the genuinely wealthy after the pandemic; no own rate/threshold.
quote_original: będą musiały zostać wprowadzone podatki majątkowe dla ludzi naprawdę zamożnych
quote_en: wealth taxes for genuinely wealthy people will have to be introduced
source_title: Musimy zrobić coś, co napawało nas grozą od czasów Gierka. Potężnie się zadłużyć i dopuścić inflację
grading_note: Interviewee explicitly changes his earlier opposing position to support named wealth taxation; date is original interview, not later quotation in OKO.press.

design_detail: Wealth tax as a progressive source for Polish defense expenditure; no fixed rate/threshold.
quote_original: sensowne byłoby wprowadzenie podatku majątkowego
quote_en: introducing a wealth tax would make sense
source_title: Istnieje alternatywa dla SAFE. Ale nie spodoba się Polakom [ANALIZA]
grading_note: Own statement quoted by the publication supports wealth taxation on the wealthiest, distinguished from corporate taxes; no specific asset-limited definition in the statement.

design_detail: At least temporary wealth taxation to finance defense of domestic assets and productive capital.
quote_original: czasowe wprowadzenie jakiejś formy podatku majątkowego
quote_en: temporary introduction of some form of wealth tax
source_title: Istnieje alternatywa dla SAFE. Ale nie spodoba się Polakom [ANALIZA]
grading_note: Own quote advocates wealth taxation in addition to corporate taxes, on the ground that defense protects local wealth and productive capital; no specified rate/threshold.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax at 0.1%, 0.3% and 0.5%; thresholds left for discussion; defense financing.
quote_original: Progresywny podatek majątkowy na poziomie 0,1, 0,3 i 0,5 proc.
quote_en: A progressive wealth tax at 0.1, 0.3 and 0.5 percent.
source_title: Trwałe wydatki na obronność wymagają trwałych źródeł finansowania. Oto pomysły [OPINIA]
grading_note: Author explicitly proposes rates for a separate progressive wealth tax alongside PIT/CIT additions; own publication recommending included tax design.

design_detail: Wealth-based defense tax, explicitly including large fortunes held in funds as one acceptable option; also lists excluded capital-gains/property options.
quote_original: Czy to od dużych majątków trzymanych w funduszach
quote_en: Whether on large fortunes held in funds
source_title: Na Kremlu widzą. Mówi, co naprawdę daje Polsce SAFE. Szczególnie istotne
grading_note: Explicitly accepts a tax on the stock of large financial holdings as one option; not included solely on his alternative income/cadastral proposals. Financial-wealth stock interpretation is inferred from the quoted reference to large fortunes held in funds; recurrence is not specified.

design_detail: 5% tax on private fortunes above PLN 5 million; programme does not explicitly state frequency.
quote_original:
Wprowadzimy podatek od prywat-
nych majątków powyżej 5 mln zł w wy -
sokości 5%.
quote_en: We will introduce a tax of 5% on private fortunes above PLN 5 million.
source_title: Partia Zieloni: Program 2018
publisher: Partia Zieloni; preserved by Archiwum Partii Politycznych ISP PAN
grading_note: Original manifesto, PDF page 11 (printed pages 20-21); broad private fortunes, distinct from its separate inheritance-tax proposal. PDF line-wrap hyphenation retained verbatim.

design_detail: Reaffirms Green programme when asked explicitly about tax on fortunes above PLN 5m.
quote_original: A nasz Zielony program pozostaje niezmienny.
quote_en: And our Green programme remains unchanged.
source_title: Tracz: Zielony prezydent powinien być odważny i łączyć ponad podziałami. I mieć plan na klimat
grading_note: In the immediately preceding question, interviewer names the Green programme tax on fortunes above PLN 5m; Tracz expressly reaffirms that programme. Her own answer, not party-membership inference.

design_detail: Progressive taxation of accumulated household wealth to reduce inequality; no rate or threshold specified.
quote_original: wprowadzić skuteczną progresję podatkową majątku, by systemowo wyrównywać szanse, likwidować nierówności oraz by budować silny budżet
quote_en: introduce effective progressive taxation of wealth to systematically equalise opportunities, eliminate inequalities and build a strong budget
source_title: Program: Progresywny podatek majątkowy
grading_note: Own programme recommends progressive taxation of accumulated household wealth rather than annual income; separate from its opening criticism of existing property taxes. source_title: Giving Europe the means for a sustainable and desirable future

source_title: Giving Europe the means for a sustainable and desirable future

design_detail: Campaign for European taxation of the super-rich's wealth, with Polish-language outreach.
quote_original: increasing taxes on their wealth.
source_title: A jet outside Parliament
grading_note: Organisation's own dated account of its wealth-tax campaign; dedicated Polish petition establishes outreach towards Poland. No private signers included.

design_detail: Global wealth tax associated with Piketty's proposal; sees it as useful but insufficient without wider structural reform.
quote_original: Jako prosty, mobilizujący postulat idea podatku majątkowego ma wiele sensu

source_title: Ostolski: Piketty i mity polskiej transformacji
grading_note: Author explicitly recommends tackling wealth differences with a global wealth tax, then calls the proposal worthwhile but insufficient; own authored-publication clause supports A.
